title: Carry
description: Carries out the rules that carry (then.carry): an item of a rule's type takes into a field of its own the promised field of what it reads across islands in a role (a reads link's props.as), on its every write, so a compare rule beside it judges what it reads. It fills what a change writes (write.rewrite) and, for a reader the change only links, adds the update (write.follow), judged with the change.
